messages:
alex: Opening a small docs PR to merge rate limits + quota quickstart and add a tiny SDK example for burst credits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Planning to add a short Grafana panel link and a note about how grace periods interact with tiered metering. @tara @miguel please eyeball the accuracy

tara: Thanks Alex — I can review tomorrow. Couple asks: 1) can we avoid using 'unlimited' in examples (confusing w/ burst credits) and 2) double-check the math in the sample table for 10k vs 100k tokens?

miguel: I can validate the metering behavior. Quick heads up — the runtime recently changed header name to `x-rw-consumption` not `x-rw-usage` so watch snippets. Also Grafana panel uid changed last week to `panel-usage-7a` (old link 404s).

alex: Good catch on header, Miguel — I'll update the snippet. For the table math I used the simplified unit cost (0.0003 per token) — tara, do you want me to show both raw tokens and normalized request-units?

jess: found a broken dashboard link in the pricing page: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage -> 404. New link is https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/panels/panel-usage-7a. I'll drop a note in the PR.

alex: Updated PR description with new header and Grafana link; added TODO to add a migration note for customers on the `x-rw-usage` header. Also included a compact SDK example (python + curl) — open to suggestions on wording.

miguel: Quick snippet suggestion: show token accounting + burst credits check before sending request. Example pseudocode is fine.

alex: Pasted a minimal python example below for review

```python
# conservative example: read remaining burst credits from header then send
import requests
API_KEY = "REDACTED"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "x-rw-consumption-since": "24h"}
# GET quota status (hypothetical endpoint)
r = requests.get("https://api.redwood.inference/v1/quota/status", headers=headers)
print(r.json())  # {"remaining_burst": 1200, "tier": "pro"}
# then choose batching based on remaining_burst
```

tara: That looks good. Suggest small copy tweak: replace 'GET quota status' w/ 'query quota status' and call out that endpoint requires tenant-scoped API key. Also add a short note about eventual consistency (may be ~60s delay).

alex: Done. Also added a one-line migration note for SDK users: "If you previously relied on x-rw-usage header, switch to x-rw-consumption and update parsing to handle nested tier objects."

jess: tiny nit — can we add an inline screenshot or a panel embed for the Grafana view? If not, at least include the panel uid + a permalink so SRE can confirm permissions.

alex: Will add panel permalink and ping eng-infra for perms. I plan to request merge after Tara approves wording and Miguel confirms header correctness.

docs-bot: PR opened by alex in docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — reviewers: @tara, @miguel. CI: spellcheck, linkcheck, snippet-lint queued.

tara: Reviewed and left a few copy suggestions inline. No blocking issues.

miguel: Validated header name and sample payload shape. Confirmed Grafana panel uid, and I asked eng-infra to whitelist the panel link. Approving from engineering side.

alex: Thanks everyone — merging once CI green and eng-infra confirms the panel link works. I'll follow up with a short migration blurb in the #release-notes channel when merged. :thumbsup:

jess: Thanks Alex, will also add the corrected console link to the pricing docs after merge.

alex: closing loop: CI green, panel link confirmed by eng-infra, merged. Follow-up: 1) release-notes blurb posted 2) backport to 1.2 branch for on-prem docs scheduled
